name: Snow Report 2026-09-21 08:00:00
report:
Thanks for another awesome summer of riding bikes! 

  • All Downhill and Upper XC & Hiking trails are now CLOSED with heavy machinery operating on the mountain as we begin preparing for Winter.
  • Lower XC Trails will remain OPEN, weather permitting, for riding with a valid day ticket or season pass. 

Please obey all mountain signage and respect all trail closures.

Winter is right around the corner with tentative winter alpine opening is set for Nov 27th! Don't forget to buy your Season Pass or 4Pack. Early Bird ends at midnight Sept 30.

name: Snow Report 2026-09-13 08:00:00
report:
Happy Sunday! 

  • SENDtember continues, with the Schralp Off from 12:00pm - 1:00pm today @ The Vault bottom berms
  • Passholder BBQ on today in the village from 11:30am - 1:30pm
  • EVOLVE's Pay Dirt sale is on now, with deals up to 70% off in store

Weather Forecast:
A weather system is skimming past our region and will bring thickening clouds Sunday, with showers possible by midday. On Monday, a weak upper level disturbance will bring increasing cloud with a chance of late day showers. Tuesday will see the beginning of a warmer and drier trend when an upper ridge builds in.
